title: React Native feature Q&A bank
purpose: Canonical question set the react-native-prompt-creator skill walks. Evaluate each question's ask_if against the node(s) + prior answers, collect answers, and emit a plain-text # FEATURE SPEC (format: feature-spec-template.md; NO JSON). Pasting that text into /tllq-workflow:feature lets Claude build with zero guessing. prompt_field names the spec section an answer fills.
notes: ask_if.node predicates are evaluated against each Figma node (get_node output). ask_if.when predicates are evaluated against already-collected answers.
per_node:true questions are asked once for EACH matching node; per_node:false (default) once per feature.
answer lands at prompt_field, a JSON path into the FEATURE SPEC ([] = array item for the current node).
candidates_source questions must be populated from a real lookup, never free-typed guesses.
required questions with no answer keep the spec incomplete -> spec.open[] is non-empty -> build is NOT deterministic; the gate must refuse or ask.

candidate_sources.openapi.specs: openapi MCP get-api-catalog (scope {projectId, repoId}) -> spec names
candidate_sources.openapi.operations: openapi MCP search-api-operations {spec, query} where query = keywords from the screen + layer name; present the TOP matches as options + 'none/other' and let the junior confirm which API is correct (never assume the first hit, never make them type an operationId)
candidate_sources.openapi.response_fields: openapi MCP load-api-operation-by-operationId {operationId} -> response schema field names
candidate_sources.codegraph.symbol: codebase-memory search_graph {qn_pattern} -> verify a named type/method exists

node_predicates._comment: Vocabulary a tool can evaluate against one Figma node to classify it. itz_<Component> is the literal React Native component name (PascalCase) — no separate lookup table, see itz-mapping.md.
node_predicates.itzBindingStatic: name matches ^itz_[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\[[^\].]+\]$ (bracket is a plain key, no leading 'data.')
node_predicates.itzInteractive: itz Component in [Button, Toggle, Switch, Slider, Picker, TextField, CheckboxView, RadioButtonView] OR (CardView|Image|TouchableOpacity|a FlatList row marked clickable)
node_predicates.isStructuralContainer: type in [FRAME, GROUP] AND has children AND has no own characters AND not isItz AND not inSkipList
node_predicates.inSkipList: name matches (?i)(status ?bar|notch|dynamic island|wifi|battery|indicator|home indicator|time\b|status icons) OR is a decorative VECTOR inside an illustration frame
node_predicates.isBlocking: not isItz AND not isStructuralContainer AND not inSkipList AND (has characters OR looks interactive) AND not inside a leaf itz_ component
node_predicates.leafItz: isItz AND Component in [Text, TextField, Button, Image, RemoteImage, Toggle, Switch, CheckboxView, RadioButtonView, Picker, LoadingIndicator, Slider, RatingView, WebView] — do NOT descend into its children; they are the component's own label/placeholder/icon
node_predicates.containerItz: isItz AND Component in [FlatList, SectionList, ScrollView, CardView, ChipGroup, View, TouchableOpacity] — DO descend; children are real components (FlatList children = the row template)

questions.question: Feature name (kebab-case, becomes the type/file base)?
Goal in one sentence?
What kind of work is this?
Is a Figma frame provided for this feature?
Figma MCP connected? (verify with get_selection / list_files)

blocking_on.message: Connect the figma-bridge MCP before continuing.

questions.question: Implement the currently selected frame ({selectionName})? The selection may not be the intended node.
questions.help: no -> ask for the intended node (re-select or paste node-id), fetch it, confirm again.

questions.question: Which node then? Select the intended frame and re-run get_selection, or paste its node-id.
Present this screen pushed onto the stack, or as a modal?
questions.help: pushed -> native-stack destination (default, drill-in flow); modal -> route registered with presentation: 'modal' (dismissible overlay, onboarding/picker-style).

questions.question: Device target?
Entry point — where is this screen launched from?
Which OpenAPI spec(s) does this feature use?
{layer}: which operation supplies this data?
{layer}: which response field binds here? (bracket says data.{suffix} — confirm, resolve ambiguity like price vs salePrice)
{layer}: static string — key '{key}', value '{text}'. Correct?
questions.help: Value goes to app/i18n/en.ts (+ vi.ts) per react-native-strings (prefix by screen).

questions.question: {layer}: on click / interaction, what happens?
{layer}: navigate to which Screen?
{layer}: navigation params (name=field, e.g. orderId=id)? blank if none
{layer}: which operation does it call?
{layer}: describe the custom behavior exactly.
{layer}: which operation returns the list items?
{layer}: confirm each row field maps its child itz_ layer to a response field (correct any).
questions.help: Children itz_ layers of the row template = the row's bound fields.

questions.question: {layer}: on item tap?
{layer}: which id field is the navigation param, and to which Screen?
{layer}: paging / refresh?
questions.help: paged -> onEndReached; pull_refresh -> RefreshControl / FlatList's refreshing+onRefresh.

questions.question: For each operation used: where does each request param come from?
Per-error-code behavior? (e.g. 401 -> relogin, else alert+retry)
Which type/screen to edit? (verified in the code graph)
What changes?
Keep-unchanged list — what must NOT change?
Repro steps · expected vs actual · device/OS version · logs?
{layer} carries text/action but is not named itz_*. Enforce-itz_: rename it in Figma, or state what it is (component + binding + action). It cannot be guessed.
